input.command:
perl -e 'alarm 20; exec @ARGV' hs -c "hs.reload()" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
TMPDIR_REAL=$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR); BEFORE=$(wc -l < "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log")
perl -e 'alarm 25; exec @ARGV' hs -c '
collectgarbage("collect"); collectgarbage("collect")   -- то, что раньше убивало tap
local function f(x) local e=hs.eventtap.event.newEvent(); e:setType(hs.eventtap.event.types.flagsChanged); e:rawFlags(x); return e end
f(0x840001):post(); hs.timer.doAfter(0.3, function() f(0):post() end)
return "GC forced, tapEnabled=" .. tostring(LocalWhisper and LocalWhisper.modTap and LocalWhisper.modTap:isEnabled())' 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 3; AFTER=$(wc -l < "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log"); echo "реакция на нажатие после GC: $((AFTER-BEFORE)) строк"; tail -3 "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log"
input.description: Force GC then test the tap survives
